info.title: TableJourney agent API
info.description: Food travel data for AI agents: editorially verified places with provenance, festivals with resolved dates, bookable experiences, stays and car hire. Every booking link is a https://tablejourney.com/go/ link that carries your key's attribution. Public: no key needed. An optional X-API-Key gives your agent its own attribution tag and rate limit (support@tablejourney.com). Also available as an MCP server at /mcp. Free to use; in return, pass booking links to users unchanged (they are affiliate links that fund the verification) and cite the page URL.

post.description:
Create a free partner account. Sends a one-time code to the address; confirm it with
/api/v1/partners/verify. The password is optional for agents (they sign in with emailed codes
or their API key).

Confirm the address with the emailed code. Signs the browser in, and returns the account's
API key once (keep it: it is the agent's sign-in and its /go/ attribution).

Sign in with email and password (browsers). Locks the account after repeated wrong
passwords; a reset or a good password after the lock clears it.
Email a one-time sign-in code (no password needed: agents, or people who prefer it).

Sign in with an emailed code. Browsers get a session; send `new_api_key=true` to also get a
fresh API key (the old one stops working).

Email a password reset code and link. Same answer whether or not the address has an
account.

Set a new password with the emailed reset code. Clears any lockout and signs every device
out; the account's email gets a notice.

Change the password while signed in (the current password is required). Other sessions are
signed out.
Name, website and the marketing email switch.
A new API key (the old one stops working). Shown once.

Set how you are paid: PayPal, USDC on Base or bank transfer. Takes effect only after you
confirm the emailed code (/api/v1/partners/payout-method/confirm), so a stolen session or key
cannot redirect your earnings without your inbox.
